title: Interactive Component Combinations
subtopics: Understanding focus, stacking, and dismissal interactions
Bootstrap's JavaScript plugins can be configured with HTML data attributes or initialized
programmatically. The official documentation also warns that Bootstrap's DOM-manipulating plugins
can conflict with front-end frameworks that manage the same DOM elements.
learning_outcomes: Explain the purpose of interactive component combinations and when it is appropriate.
Apply modal forms using the documented Bootstrap 5.3 pattern.
Check dropdowns inside navigation and identify one likely failure mode.

common_mistakes.problem: Treating interactive component combinations as a visual-only change.
common_mistakes.why: A class or style does not automatically add semantic meaning, application logic, or secure server behavior.
common_mistakes.fix: Use the appropriate HTML semantics and verify the actual interaction.

common_mistakes.problem: Checking only the default viewport or happy path.
common_mistakes.why: Responsive changes and interaction states can reveal issues that are not visible in a single screenshot.
common_mistakes.fix: Repeat the task at a narrow and a wide viewport and include keyboard/error state checks where relevant.
